input_fields.name: stale_reference_location
input_fields.description: Source location and old reference/collection consumed after mutation.

input_fields.name: topology_change_point
input_fields.description: Single operation that changed topology and its output identity.

input_fields.name: consumers
input_fields.description: Downstream consumers; one repair target is required.

result_fields.name: refresh_point
result_fields.description: One copyable enumeration statement/insertion location after mutation.

result_fields.name: refreshed_reference_binding
result_fields.description: Old consumer binding replaced by current-topology binding.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when mutation/consumer causality or API enumeration is unknown.

procedure: Locate mutation and first stale consumer in source order.
Insert one current enumeration at post-mutation boundary, e.g. bodies = list(GetRootPart().GetAllBodies()) or faces = list(body.Faces).

Return the exact enumeration point and consumer binding. If selecting one object requires an unavailable selector/helper/tolerance, leave that binding unresolved; do not introduce undefined helpers or hide a selection operation inside refresh.
If API/boundary is unknown, return needs_manual_review instead of guessing.
rejection_rules: Reject refresh before mutation, unrelated consumer, or fabricated API.
Do not change the topology operation.
Do not claim downstream geometry success before execution/check.
